scope: Native owned-PC LOOPSKILL request/ACK, resource and shared live-timer gates, plus non-consuming equipment eligibility.

source_authority.contract: Original loop request fields; cooldown before MP before HP; HP equality allowed; target active prerequisite then UseSkillItem; own SDELAY_LOOP without SkillUse shared-kind extension.
LOOPSKILL_ACK has a fixed 45-byte body including target count, followed by DWORD/BYTE target rows; no ordinary animation or transform fields.
Loop delay is (dwLoopDelay + attack speed) * rate / 100 with DWORD wrapping and no rank increment.
UseSkillItem checks item consumption, weapon mask, first matching powered equipment and ammunition; CheckPrevAct requires a maintained effect, not a learned skill.
Source wItemID binds positionally to m_wUseItem; pinned backup values remain unchanged.
Client CANCELSKILL follows inability to activate an acknowledged cast. Cancellation needs an authoritative cast lifecycle before exposing cooldown reset.

implementation.wire: CS_LOOPSKILL_REQ 0x5372 uses its original 23-byte header/count and strict complete target parsing. CS_LOOPSKILL_ACK 0x5373 uses the original 45-byte fixed layout.
implementation.authority: Existing ready-primary gameplay operation fence plus exact owned PC/channel/map and learned skill checks. Replica, transferred, malformed and foreign actor requests cannot perform a loop cast.
implementation.atomicity: Character lock encloses all checks, live own-timer arming and exact learned-rank HP/MP deduction. Loop checks cooldown first and accepts HP equal to cost. It never extends shared-kind peers. Ordinary skill-use behavior remains unchanged.
implementation.timing: Fresh and transferred hydration load original dwLoopDelay and wTargetActiveID. Both cast forms share the same tracker, snapshots, checkpoints, logout and recovery.
implementation.equipment: Per-character cached loop eligibility follows source item-free/no-weapon and first matching powered equipment with no ammunition. Broken or missing matching equipment returns UNSUITWEAPON. Reagent, ammunition/cash bypass and out-of-range source shift cases are unsupported and close before mutation.
implementation.effects: Missing required active effect in an unbuffed graph returns NEEDPREVACT. Buff-bearing effect prerequisites remain unsupported; stored/learned effects are not guessed as active. Existing speed-dependent buff rejection remains.
implementation.migration: None; backups and migrations 001-021 unchanged; next migration remains 022.

regression_before.scope: Previous installed admission-timers daemons; current mounted backend executable. Encrypted peer times out waiting for the unimplemented loop ACK.

targeted.scope: Initial packet golden bytes, DWORD/rank loop arithmetic and plain/encrypted native loop resource/timer gates. The subsequent full CTest run also covers unsupported consumable and active-effect refusal.

limitations: Full damage/healing, combat powers, peace-zone/target/action validation, multi-hit expansion and other gameplay remain unfinished, as in the preceding ordinary cast scope.
Only native owned-PC loops are implemented. Legacy no-payload and monster/recall/secondary casting have no new behavior.
Consumable inventory transactions, active buff lifetime semantics and cancellation remain separate ports.
Equipment and learned-skill mutations must rebuild both derived timing and loop item eligibility.
No original client executable was run; actual TCP uses source-derived encrypted synthetic peers.
